sentences.english: It was nice talking to you.

Hello, what is your Chinese name?

My name is Li Hua. What is your surname?
I am also very glad to meet you.
She is my friend. Her name is Anna.
Her Chinese name is Wang Ling.
Great, let's go say hello to her.
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了，我们去跟她打个招呼吧。

sentences.english: I am from a small town.

conversation_script.text_en: No, I live in Shanghai now.
Yes, it is a very big city.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的,那是一个非常大的城市。

conversation_script.text_en: I would like to visit it someday.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我希望有一天去那里参观。

sentences.chinese: 这位游客是澳大利亚人。

conversation_script.text_zh: 哦,所以你是几内亚人吗？

conversation_script.text_en: That's right. Do you know people from other countries?
conversation_script.text_zh: 没错。你认识其他国家的人吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes. My classmates are Canadian, American, and Indian.
conversation_script.text_zh: 认识。我的同学有加拿大人、美国人和印度人。

conversation_script.text_en: I have friends from France, Spain, and Korea.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我有来自法国、西班牙和韩国的朋友。

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, and I also know a German and an Australian.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的,我还认识一位德国人和一位澳大利亚人。

conversation_script.text_en: It's great to meet people from different countries.
conversation_script.text_zh: 认识来自不同国家的人真棒。

conversation_script.text_en: The world is a big place.

sentences.english: I can understand a little Chinese.

sentences.chinese: 让我们一起练习英语吧。

sentences.english: We are having a conversation in English.
I want to speak English fluently.

conversation_script.text_en: Hi, what languages do you speak?
That's great. Do you speak Chinese too?
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了。你也会说中文吗？

conversation_script.text_en: A little. I am still learning.
No, but I want to learn French.

conversation_script.text_zh: 法语是一门优美的语言。

conversation_script.text_en: Do you practice English every day?
Yes, I practice with my friends.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的,我和朋友一起练习。

conversation_script.text_en: How often do you practice English?

conversation_script.text_zh: 你的英语会进步得很快。

sentences.english: My sister is younger than me.
My brother is older than me.
The child is five years old.

conversation_script.text_en: Really? I am eleven years old.
So you are one year older than me.

conversation_script.text_zh: 是的。你的生日是什么时候？

conversation_script.text_en: That's nice. My birthday is in December.
conversation_script.text_zh: 真不错。我的生日在十二月。

conversation_script.text_en: Do you have a birthday party?
Yes, we eat cake and play games.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的,我们吃蛋糕和玩游戏。

sentences.english: I am having a birthday party.
There is a big cake on the table.
Many guests come to my party.
sentences.chinese: 许多客人来参加我的聚会。
每个人都唱生日快乐歌。
我度过了一个美好的生日。

conversation_script.text_en: I am eleven years old now.
Are you having a birthday party?
Yes, my friends are coming this afternoon.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的,我的朋友们今天下午会来。

conversation_script.text_en: Do you have a birthday cake?
Yes, it is a chocolate cake.
I wish for good health and happiness.
Thank you! Let's enjoy the party.
conversation_script.text_zh: 谢谢！让我们享受聚会吧。

sentences.chinese: 让我介绍一下我的朋友。

sentences.english: We have known each other for two years.
My friend speaks English and Chinese.
sentences.chinese: 我的朋友会说英语和中文。
每个人都喜欢我的朋友。

conversation_script.text_en: Hi Kevin, this is my friend Sarah.
Hello Sarah, nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you too, Kevin.
Really? Which class are you in?
We are in the same English class.
Sarah is very kind and helpful.
conversation_script.text_zh: Sarah非常友善而且乐于助人。

conversation_script.text_en: I'm happy to meet new friends.

sentences.chinese: 你的中文老师在这儿吗？

sentences.english: Is that tall person your friend?
sentences.chinese: 那个高的人是你的朋友吗？

sentences.english: Is the student inside the school now?
sentences.chinese: 现在学生在学校里面吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Hello! Yes, I am a student.
No, he is not a student. He is a teacher.
conversation_script.text_zh: 不是，他不是学生。他是老师。

conversation_script.text_en: Oh, is he your Chinese teacher?
conversation_script.text_zh: 哦，他是你的中文老师吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, he is my Chinese teacher.
Is that girl over there a teacher too?
conversation_script.text_zh: 那边的那个女孩也是老师吗？

conversation_script.text_en: No, she is a doctor. She is my friend.
conversation_script.text_zh: 不是，她是医生。她是我的朋友。

conversation_script.text_en: Is this small cat her cat?
No, that is not her cat.
Do you have a cat or a dog?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你有一只猫还是一条狗？

conversation_script.text_en: I have a big dog. Is that your dog outside?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我有一条大狗。外面的那是你的狗吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, that big white dog is mine.
conversation_script.text_zh: 对，那条白色的大狗是我的。

conversation_script.text_en: It is very beautiful. Is it friendly?
Yes, it is very good. Let's go outside and see it.
conversation_script.text_zh: 对，它非常好。我们去外面看看它吧。

sentences.chinese: 你最喜欢的食物是什么？

sentences.english: I am happy because it is my birthday.
sentences.chinese: 我很开心,因为今天是我的生日。

sentences.english: How do you go to school?
I go to school by bus.
WH- questions help us get information.
sentences.chinese: WH问题帮助我们获取信息。

conversation_script.text_en: Hi, can I ask you some questions?
conversation_script.text_zh: 嗨,我可以问你几个问题吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Because I want to make international friends.
conversation_script.text_zh: 因为我想结交国际朋友。

sentences.chinese: 简短回答让对话更容易。

sentences.english: Can you open the door, please?
Excuse me, where is the library?
sentences.chinese: 打扰一下,图书馆在哪里？

conversation_script.text_en: Excuse me, can you help me?
conversation_script.text_zh: 打扰一下,你能帮助我吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Can you tell me where the bus stop is, please?
conversation_script.text_zh: 请问你能告诉我公交车站在哪里吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, there is one across the street.

sentences.english: Excuse me, where is the restroom?
sentences.chinese: 打扰一下,洗手间在哪里？

sentences.english: Excuse me, may I sit here?
sentences.chinese: 打扰一下,我可以坐这里吗？

sentences.english: Excuse me, can you help me?
sentences.chinese: 打扰一下,你能帮助我吗？
对不起,我忘记你的名字了。

conversation_script.text_en: Excuse me, is this seat free?
conversation_script.text_zh: 打扰一下,这个座位有人吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Oh, sorry! I dropped my bag.
conversation_script.text_zh: 哦,对不起！我的包掉下来了。

conversation_script.text_en: Excuse me, what time is it?

conversation_script.text_zh: 对不起,你能再说一遍吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Sorry, I need to leave now.

sentences.english: Can you say it more slowly?
How do you pronounce this word?

conversation_script.text_en: Excuse me, what did you say?
conversation_script.text_zh: 打扰一下,你刚才说什么？

conversation_script.text_en: I said my birthday is in September.

conversation_script.text_zh: 对不起,你能重复一遍吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Sure. My birthday is in September.
Thank you. Please speak a little more slowly.
No problem. My birthday is in Sep-tem-ber.
conversation_script.text_zh: 没问题。我的生日在九月。

sentences.english: Can you speak a little louder?
How do you pronounce this word?
Can you spell it for me?
Listening is important when learning English.
sentences.chinese: 学习英语时听力很重要。

conversation_script.text_zh: 我最喜欢的爱好是摄影。
对不起,你能重复一遍吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Sure. My favorite hobby is photography.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然。我最喜欢的爱好是摄影。

conversation_script.text_en: Please speak a little more slowly.

conversation_script.text_zh: 我最喜欢的爱好是摄-影。

conversation_script.text_en: It means taking pictures with a camera.
conversation_script.text_zh: 它的意思是用相机拍照。

conversation_script.text_en: I see. How do you pronounce it?
Can you spell it for me?

sentences.english: Can you give me an example?
Can you say that more clearly?
sentences.chinese: 你能说得更清楚一点吗？
练习帮助我更好地理解。

conversation_script.text_en: Today we will learn a new word: 'journey'.
conversation_script.text_zh: 今天我们学习一个新单词: journey。

conversation_script.text_en: No problem. 'Journey' means a trip from one place to another.
conversation_script.text_zh: 没关系。Journey 的意思是从一个地方到另一个地方的旅行。

conversation_script.text_en: Can you give me an example?
Sure. My journey from home to school takes thirty minutes.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然。我从家到学校的路程需要三十分钟。

conversation_script.text_en: Can you say that more slowly?
Of course. It means it needs time.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然。它的意思是需要时间。

conversation_script.text_en: Great! Do you have another question?
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了！你还有别的问题吗？

conversation_script.text_en: I will. Thank you for your help.

sentences.chinese: 让我介绍一下我的同学。

sentences.english: Today is my first day here.
sentences.chinese: 今天是我来这里的第一天。

sentences.english: I am happy to meet new people.
He greeted everyone with a smile.
We shook hands and introduced ourselves.
sentences.chinese: 我们握手并做了自我介绍。

sentences.english: It was a pleasure meeting you.
I hope we can be friends.
sentences.chinese: 我希望我们能成为朋友。

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, today is my first day.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的,今天是我的第一天。

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you. My name is Kevin.
Nice to meet you too, Sarah.
That's wonderful. I have never been there.
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了。我从没去过那里。

conversation_script.text_en: Maybe you can visit one day.
conversation_script.text_zh: 也许有一天你可以去看看。

conversation_script.text_en: Do you have many students in this class?

sentences.english: I wake up early in the morning.
We have lunch in the afternoon.
I study English in the evening.
I go to sleep at night.
The sun rises in the morning.
The sun sets in the evening.
Good morning! How are you today?
Good afternoon! Nice to see you again.
sentences.chinese: 下午好！很高兴再次见到你。

conversation_script.text_en: I'm great, thank you. And you?
What time do your classes start?
They start at eight o'clock in the morning.
Good afternoon, Sarah. How was your day?
conversation_script.text_zh: 下午好,Sarah。你今天过得怎么样？

conversation_script.text_en: What do you do in the evening?
I study English and read books.
Good night, Sarah. See you tomorrow.

sentences.english: I speak English, French, and Chinese.
sentences.chinese: 我会说英语、法语和中文。
我最喜欢的爱好是阅读。
我很友好并且乐于助人。

sentences.english: This is some information about me.
sentences.chinese: 这是一些关于我的信息。

sentences.english: A short introduction is easy to remember.
sentences.chinese: 简短的自我介绍容易记住。

sentences.english: Five sentences are enough for a basic introduction.
sentences.chinese: 五句话足够完成一个基础自我介绍。

conversation_script.text_en: Hello everyone. Let me introduce myself.
conversation_script.text_zh: 大家好。让我介绍一下自己。

conversation_script.text_en: I speak English, French, and Chinese.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我会说英语、法语和中文。
这是一个很好的自我介绍。

conversation_script.text_en: How long have you been learning English?
I have been learning English for two years.
I want to improve my speaking skills.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我想提高我的口语能力。

conversation_script.text_en: I will. Thank you for listening.

sentences.english: There are three apples on the table.
There are six chairs in the room.
Nine students are in the class.
Ten is a big number for a child.
sentences.chinese: 十对于孩子来说是一个大数字。

sentences.english: Can you count from one to ten?
How many books do you have?

conversation_script.text_en: Can you count from zero to ten?
Five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.
Excellent! How many fingers do you have on one hand?
conversation_script.text_zh: 太棒了！你一只手有几根手指？

conversation_script.text_en: I have five fingers on one hand.
How many days are in a week?
There are seven days in a week.
How many students are in your group?

sentences.english: There are twelve months in a year.
Fourteen students are in the classroom.
Sixteen chairs are in the room.
Seventeen people came to the party.
There are eighteen apples in the basket.
Nineteen birds are in the tree.
Twenty students are in our class.
Can you count from eleven to twenty?
sentences.chinese: 你能从十一数到二十吗？

sentences.english: My brother is eighteen years old.
Learning numbers helps in daily life.
sentences.chinese: 学习数字有助于日常生活。

conversation_script.text_en: Can you count from eleven to twenty?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你能从十一数到二十吗？
十一、十二、十三、十四、十五。
十六、十七、十八、十九、二十。

conversation_script.text_en: Excellent! How old is your sister?
How many students are in your class?
Do you know how many months are in a year?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你知道一年有多少个月吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Let's practice these numbers again later.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们稍后再练习这些数字。

sentences.english: Twenty students are in the classroom.
My father is thirty years old.
There are fifty chairs in the hall.
My grandfather is seventy years old.
Ninety birds flew over the lake.
One hundred is a big number.
Count by tens from twenty to one hundred.
sentences.chinese: 按十为单位从二十数到一百。

sentences.english: I can count to one hundred.
Learning tens helps with shopping and counting.
sentences.chinese: 学习整十数有助于购物和数数。

conversation_script.text_en: Sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety, one hundred.
conversation_script.text_zh: 六十、七十、八十、九十、一百。

conversation_script.text_en: Excellent! How old is your grandfather?
Can you count to one hundred?
Numbers are very useful in daily life.
conversation_script.text_zh: 数字在日常生活中非常有用。

sentences.english: One hundred students are in the school.
Two hundred people attended the event.
The bicycle costs five hundred yuan.
sentences.chinese: 这辆自行车价值五百元。

sentences.english: Nine hundred books are in the library.
There are one thousand people in the village.
My phone costs two thousand yuan.
Three thousand people visited the museum.
Can you count to one thousand?
The population is about two thousand.
Five hundred plus five hundred equals one thousand.
The total amount is three thousand dollars.
We use hundreds and thousands every day.
sentences.chinese: 我们每天都会使用百位数和千位数。

conversation_script.text_en: Correct. How much does your computer cost?
How many students are in your school?
Yes, it is a large school.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，那是一所很大的学校。

conversation_script.text_en: I want to practice bigger numbers.
Great! We will learn more next lesson.
conversation_script.text_zh: 很好！我们下一课会学习更多。

sentences.english: Can you repeat your phone number?
sentences.chinese: 你能重复一下你的电话号码吗？

sentences.english: I use my mobile phone every day.
Can you text me your number?
sentences.chinese: 你能把号码发短信给我吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Hi Sarah, what is your phone number?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你好Sarah，你的电话号码是多少？

conversation_script.text_en: Sure. One three five, six seven eight nine, four three two one.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然。一三五，六七八九，四三二一。

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you. Let me write it down.
Is this your mobile phone number?

conversation_script.text_zh: 我会保存你的联系方式。

conversation_script.text_en: Great. I will save yours too.
Can I send you a message later?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我稍后可以给你发消息吗？

conversation_script.text_en: If I have the wrong number, please tell me.
conversation_script.text_zh: 如果我记错号码，请告诉我。

conversation_script.text_en: Sure, but I think it's correct.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然，不过我觉得是正确的。

sentences.english: I want to buy a new bag.
She paid twenty yuan for lunch.
The total amount is fifty dollars.

sentences.chinese: 这个笔记本价值十五元。

sentences.english: He sells fruit at the market.

sentences.chinese: 学习价格表达有助于购物。

conversation_script.text_en: Excuse me, how much is this T-shirt?
Yes, it is on sale today.
I would like to buy it.
Thank you. Your change is five dollars.

sentences.english: I am the first person in line.
sentences.chinese: 我是队伍中的第一个人。

sentences.english: He came third in the race.
sentences.chinese: 他在比赛中获得第三名。

sentences.english: My classroom is on the fourth floor.
Today is the fifth day of the month.
Her birthday is on the sixth of June.
My seat is in the eighth row.
He lives on the tenth floor.
Who is first in the competition?
The winner is in first place.
What is your position in the line?
sentences.chinese: 你在队伍中的位置是第几？

conversation_script.text_en: Who finished first in the race?
conversation_script.text_zh: 谁在比赛中获得第一名？

conversation_script.text_en: Great! What floor is your classroom on?
It is on the fourth floor.
What row do you sit in?
I sit in the third row.
Today is the seventh of May.
Excellent! You know ordinal numbers well.
conversation_script.text_zh: 太棒了！你很会使用序数词。

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you. I practice every day.

sentences.chinese: 星期一是第一个工作日。

sentences.english: I have English class on Tuesday.
My music lesson is on Thursday.

sentences.chinese: 星期五是我最喜欢的工作日。

sentences.english: There are seven days in a week.
Saturday and Sunday are the weekend.
sentences.chinese: 星期六和星期日是周末。

sentences.english: My schedule is busy this week.

conversation_script.text_en: Do you have English class today?
No, my English class is on Tuesday.
conversation_script.text_zh: 没有，我的英语课在星期二。

conversation_script.text_en: What do you do on Wednesday?
What is your favorite day of the week?

conversation_script.text_zh: 星期五是我最喜欢的一天。

conversation_script.text_en: What do you do on the weekend?
I visit my grandparents on Saturday and relax on Sunday.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我星期六去看爷爷奶奶，星期日休息。

sentences.english: January is the first month of the year.
sentences.chinese: 一月是一年的第一个月。
二月是一个较短的月份。

sentences.english: My sister was born in April.

sentences.chinese: 五月是我最喜欢的月份。

sentences.english: June is the sixth month of the year.
sentences.chinese: 六月是一年的第六个月。

sentences.english: The weather is cool in November.
December is the last month of the year.
sentences.chinese: 十二月是一年的最后一个月。

sentences.english: There are twelve months in a year.

conversation_script.text_en: How many months are there in a year?
There are twelve months in a year.
Really? My birthday is in September.
conversation_script.text_zh: 真的吗？我的生日在九月。

conversation_script.text_en: That's nice. September is a good month.
conversation_script.text_zh: 真不错。九月是个好月份。

conversation_script.text_en: Which month do you like the most?

conversation_script.text_zh: 六月是一个美丽的月份。

conversation_script.text_en: Let's practice all the months together.
conversation_script.text_zh: 让我们一起练习所有月份吧。

sentences.english: Her birthday is on the third of March.
My appointment is on the twenty-first of August.
There are many holidays in December.
Can you say the date in English?
I marked the date on my calendar.
sentences.chinese: 我在日历上标记了日期。

sentences.english: Learning dates is useful for daily life.
sentences.chinese: 学习日期对日常生活很有帮助。

conversation_script.text_en: Can you say it another way?
Yes. Today is the fifteenth of June, twenty twenty-six.
How do you say that in English?
Yes. We use dates for birthdays, meetings, and holidays.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的。我们用日期来表示生日、会议和节日。

conversation_script.text_en: I will practice writing dates every day.

sentences.chinese: 星期四是我最喜欢的一天。
星期五是一周工作日的最后一天。

sentences.english: I do not work on the weekend.

sentences.chinese: 我最喜欢的一天是星期日。

conversation_script.text_en: Hi! What day is it today?
Oh, really? I thought it was Wednesday.
conversation_script.text_zh: 哦，真的吗？我以为今天是星期三。

conversation_script.text_en: No, look at the calendar. It says Thursday.
conversation_script.text_zh: 不是，看日历。上面写着星期四。

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you! Is tomorrow a weekday?
Yes, tomorrow is Friday. It is a weekday.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，明天是星期五。是工作日。

conversation_script.text_en: What about Saturday? Is it a weekday?
conversation_script.text_zh: 那星期六呢？是工作日吗？

conversation_script.text_en: I like the weekend. What is your favorite day?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我喜欢周末。你最喜欢哪一天？
我最喜欢的一天是星期日。

conversation_script.text_en: Because I do not work on Sunday.
conversation_script.text_zh: 因为我星期日不用上班。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay, I understand now. Thank you!
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的，我现在明白了。谢谢！

conversation_script.text_en: You are welcome! Have a nice Thursday!
conversation_script.text_zh: 不客气！祝你星期四愉快！

sentences.chinese: 五月是一个温暖的月份。

sentences.english: The date is on the calendar.

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, June is warm. July is hotter.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，六月很暖和。七月更热。
我最喜欢的月份是十二月。

conversation_script.text_en: Because my birthday is in December.
conversation_script.text_zh: 因为我的生日在十二月。

conversation_script.text_en: April is a nice month. What date?
It is April 3rd. Let's look at the calendar!
conversation_script.text_zh: 四月三日。我们来看日历吧！

conversation_script.text_en: Okay! Here is the calendar. Happy birthday to us!
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的！这是日历。祝我们生日快乐！

sentences.english: What is the sum of four and five?
Yes, I can count to ten.
One hundred is a big number.

conversation_script.text_en: Hi! Can you help me with math?
Sure! What do you want to add?
Okay! What about three plus two?
Great! Can you count to ten?
Yes! One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的！一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九、十。

conversation_script.text_en: Wow! What is five plus five?
I think I understand now. Thank you!
conversation_script.text_zh: 我想我现在明白了。谢谢！

conversation_script.text_en: You are welcome! Numbers are fun!
Hi! Can you help me with subtraction?
Sure! What do you want to subtract?
Okay! What about three minus one?
I have six apples. I eat two.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我有六个苹果。我吃了两个。

conversation_script.text_en: Six minus two equals four. Four apples are left!
conversation_script.text_zh: 六减二等于四。还剩四个苹果！

conversation_script.text_en: Very good! What is ten minus four?
Great! What is four minus four?
You are very smart! Subtraction is fun!

sentences.english: I have three groups of apples.

conversation_script.text_en: Hi! Can you teach me multiplication?
Sure! It is easy. What is two times two?
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然！很简单。二乘二是多少？

conversation_script.text_en: Very good! What about three times one?
Great! Now, I have three groups of apples.
conversation_script.text_zh: 太棒了！现在，我有三组苹果。

conversation_script.text_en: How many apples in each group?
Three times two equals six. Six apples total!
conversation_script.text_zh: 三乘二等于六。总共六个苹果！

conversation_script.text_en: I see! What is four times two?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我明白了！四乘二是多少？

conversation_script.text_en: You are welcome! You are very smart!

sentences.english: Four divided by two equals two.
Six divided by three equals two.
What is eight divided by two?
Eight divided by two equals four.
Ten divided by two equals five.
I want to share with my friend.

sentences.chinese: 我们每人得到三块饼干。

sentences.english: Six divided by two equals three.
Four divided by four equals one.

conversation_script.text_en: Hi! Can you teach me division?
Sure! It means to share equally. What is four divided by two?
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然！它的意思是平均分配。四除以二是多少？

conversation_script.text_en: Four divided by two equals two!
Very good! What about six divided by three?
Six divided by three equals two.
Great! I have six cookies. I want to share with you.
conversation_script.text_zh: 太棒了！我有六块饼干。我想和你分享。

conversation_script.text_en: How many cookies do we each get?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们每人得到多少块饼干？

conversation_script.text_en: Six divided by two equals three. We each get three.
conversation_script.text_zh: 六除以二等于三。我们每人得到三块。

conversation_script.text_en: The parts are equal! What is eight divided by two?
conversation_script.text_zh: 这些部分是相等的！八除以二是多少？

conversation_script.text_en: Eight divided by two equals four.
And what is half of ten?
Half of ten is five. Ten divided by two equals five.
conversation_script.text_zh: 十的一半是五。十除以二等于五。

conversation_script.text_en: What is four divided by four?
Four divided by four equals one.
You are welcome! Sharing is fun!

sentences.english: I have more apples than you.
You have less money than me.
How many more do you have?

conversation_script.text_en: Okay! Is five more than two?
Yes, five is more than two.
And is two less than five?
Yes, two is less than five.
What about ten and five? Which is bigger?
And one and two? Which is smaller?
I have five apples. You have two apples.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我有五个苹果。你有两个苹果。

conversation_script.text_en: You have more apples than me!
Yes, and you have less than me.
What if we both have five?
Then we are equal. They are the same!
conversation_script.text_zh: 那我们是相等的。它们是相同的！

conversation_script.text_en: Comparing numbers is easy! Thank you!
You are welcome! You are very smart!

sentences.chinese: 四分之一等于百分之二十五。

sentences.english: I cut the pizza into two parts.
I cut the pizza into four parts.
One hundred percent is the whole.
Fifty percent is half of the whole.
sentences.chinese: 百分之五十是全部的一半。
百分之二十五是四分之一。

sentences.english: I want to share the pizza.
One third is about thirty-three percent.
sentences.chinese: 三分之一大约是百分之三十三。

sentences.english: The whole pizza is one hundred percent.
Can you divide it into parts?
sentences.chinese: 你能把它分成几部分吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Hi! I have a whole pizza. Do you want some?
conversation_script.text_zh: 嗨！我有一个完整的披萨。你想吃吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes! But what is a whole?
A whole is one hundred percent. It is everything.
conversation_script.text_zh: 全部是百分之百。是所有东西。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay! Can we cut it into two parts?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的！我们可以把它切成两部分吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Sure! Each part is one half. That is fifty percent.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然！每部分是一半。那是百分之五十。

conversation_script.text_en: I see! What if we cut it into four parts?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我明白了！如果我们切成四部分呢？

conversation_script.text_en: Each part is one quarter. That is twenty-five percent.
conversation_script.text_zh: 每部分是四分之一。那是百分之二十五。

conversation_script.text_en: Wow! So four quarters equal the whole?
conversation_script.text_zh: 哇！所以四个四分之一等于全部？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes! Four quarters equal one hundred percent.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的！四个四分之一等于百分之百。

conversation_script.text_en: What about three parts? What fraction is that?
conversation_script.text_zh: 那三部分呢？那是什么分数？

conversation_script.text_en: That is one third. It is about thirty-three percent.
conversation_script.text_zh: 那是三分之一。大约是百分之三十三。

conversation_script.text_en: I understand! Half is fifty percent.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我明白了！一半是百分之五十。

conversation_script.text_en: Yes! And quarter is twenty-five percent.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的！而且四分之一是百分之二十五。

conversation_script.text_en: Can we share the pizza now?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们现在可以分享披萨了吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Sure! I get one half, and you get one half.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然！我得到一半，你得到一半。

sentences.english: I want to buy two items.
Two dollars plus three dollars equals five dollars.
sentences.chinese: 两美元加三美元等于五美元。

sentences.english: The total cost is five dollars.
I need to pay five dollars.
One item costs one dollar and fifty cents.
sentences.chinese: 一个商品花费一美元五十美分。

sentences.english: Fifty cents plus fifty cents equals one dollar.
sentences.chinese: 五十美分加五十美分等于一美元。

sentences.english: The total price is ten dollars.

conversation_script.text_en: Hi! I want to buy some items. How much is this pen?
conversation_script.text_zh: 嗨！我想买一些商品。这支笔多少钱？

conversation_script.text_en: So two dollars plus three dollars equals five dollars?
conversation_script.text_zh: 所以两美元加三美元等于五美元？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes! The total cost is five dollars.
What about this eraser? How much is it?
It is cheap. Only fifty cents.
conversation_script.text_zh: 它很便宜。只要五十美分。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay, I want the pen, the notebook, and the eraser.
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的，我想要这支笔、这个笔记本和这个橡皮。

conversation_script.text_en: Five dollars plus fifty cents equals five dollars and fifty cents.
conversation_script.text_zh: 五美元加五十美分等于五美元五十美分。

conversation_script.text_en: The total is five dollars and fifty cents.
conversation_script.text_zh: 总计是五美元五十美分。

conversation_script.text_en: I have ten dollars. Do I have enough money?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我有十美元。我有足够的钱吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes! Ten dollars is more than five dollars and fifty cents.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的！十美元比五美元五十美分多。

conversation_script.text_en: Great! I will pay now. Here is the money.
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了！我现在支付。给你钱。

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you! Here is your change. Have a nice day!
conversation_script.text_zh: 谢谢！这是你的找零。祝你愉快！
